title: Курс из прошлого
setup:
insert into currency values (100, 'EUR', 0.85, '2022-01-01 13:29');
insert into currency values (100, 'EUR', 0.79, '2022-01-08 13:29');

positive.sql:
SELECT b.user_id, b.currency_id, b.money, b.updated, t.rate_to_usd AS rate_t1
FROM balance b
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT c.rate_to_usd FROM currency c
                   WHERE c.id = b.currency_id AND c.updated <= b.updated
                   ORDER BY c.updated DESC LIMIT 1) t ON true
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM currency c WHERE c.id = b.currency_id)
ORDER BY b.user_id, b.updated, b.currency_id, b.money;

negative.why: граница строгая (<): курс в тот же момент не учтён
negative.sql:
SELECT b.user_id, b.currency_id, b.money, b.updated,
       (SELECT c.rate_to_usd
        FROM currency c
        WHERE c.id = b.currency_id AND c.updated < b.updated
        ORDER BY c.updated DESC
        LIMIT 1) AS rate_t1
FROM balance b
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM currency c WHERE c.id = b.currency_id)
ORDER BY b.user_id, b.updated, b.currency_id, b.money;

negative.why: взят самый старый курс вместо ближайшего
